modules.module_title: Shift hand over and take charge in draw frame department

pcs.pc_description: report for the shift 10-15 minutes prior to the scheduled time with necessary operational tools
collect the shift details from previous shift operator on production, maintenance, raw material, colour coding, etc. as per the SOP
check for quality and availability of spares, production materials such as sliver cans, colour code strip, cleaning liquids and powder, etc.
monitor condition of processing materials and accessories in the allotted draw frame machines such as creel guides, drafting rollers, can coiler, waste collection box, etc.
check work spot and draw frame machine for cleanliness as per specifications
provide shift details to incoming draw frame operator on production, maintenance, spare parts, counts running, count changes, sliver cans availability, etc.
complete the shift end jobs like take hank meter reading, writing production log report, waste collection box disposal, cleaning as per standard protocol
report observed deviation to incoming shift supervisor on production, maintenance, absenteeism, etc.
get clearance from shift operator and shift supervisor before leaving the shift
operate draw frame machine using control buttons provided for start, inch, stop, emergency stop, etc.
operate draw frame machine display panel and check the functioning of the machine such as machine speed, production, efficiency, doff set, running length, machine stoppages, etc.
follow the different signal lamps used in draw frame machines
fix machine safety covers, waste collection chamber doors as per the guidelines
dismantle and assemble detachable spares like top drafting rollers, clearers, sliver trumpet, etc.

modules.module_title: Attend draw frame machine for sliver can change

pcs.pc_description: transfer supply sliver cans from storage area as per specified colour code and hank
identify the sliver can exhaust in the draw frame creel
inspect for surface damages of slivers before creeling operation
piece full can sliver with running can sliver before exhaustion as per the SOP
remove the exhausted cans from creel and store at specified place

modules.module_title: Piece broken sliver in the draw frame creel side

pcs.pc_description: identity the machine stoppage by checking signal lamps and display panel
verify the required length of sliver is available for piecing
piece the broken sliver in the creel section as per standard procedure and guidelines
monitor the sliver passage after piecing in the running machine
collect the sliver waste in the waste collection pocket and dispose in the waste collection box

modules.module_title: Piece broken sliver at draw frame front side

pcs.pc_description: attend trumpet chocking, roller lapping, etc. as per standard procedure and guidelines

modules.module_title: Perform can doffing at draw frame machine

pcs.pc_description: collect and bring required empty cans from storage area for manual or automatic doffing
clean the can castor wheels as per standard process
identify the machine doffing stage using control panel
carryout doffing process as per standard guidelines
monitor the coiling placement in new can after doffing
transport full can to the storage area

modules.module_title: Carryout cleaning activities at draw frame machine

pcs.pc_description: carryout cleaning activities in the draw frame machine as per scheduled interval using appropriate tools
segregate the collected waste to deposit in the respective waste bins
remove the surface defect and impurities on the slivers
support spinning fitters in their cleaning and maintenance activities

modules.module_title: Carryout other tenting responsibilities in draw frame department

pcs.pc_description: inform the machine break downs, faults, repeated breakages to fitters as per the standard process

maintain stocks of required cleaning materials
monitor the working condition of creel guides, drafting unit, coiling unit, waste chamber, etc. at specified intervals
change colour code belt for sliver cans as per the instruction
support maintenance and quality control team within limits of responsibility
